svg.title: NYC Taxi Data Engineering — M2.3 RustFS publication
svg.desc: sbt upload and runMain RustFsUpload parse the configuration, lock RAW_DIR, ensure the nyc-taxi bucket, and publish three trip files and two reference files. Each object is created conditionally, re-read for SHA-256, decoded by Spark when it is Parquet, and followed by its provenance. Only a fully verified run writes an immutable receipt.

g.text: exo1_data_retrieval: verified local sources into bucket nyc-taxi, never overwriting an object
A new snapshot needs a new descriptor
publishItem, one source at a time
byte. Each upload costs twice its size.
A failed run leaves accepted objects
